## Description

`ORIENTED_EDGE` whose `edge_element` slot is `*` or null reference (or unresolved id), or — conversely — derived attributes `edge_start`/`edge_end` filled with explicit vertices instead of `*`.

## Reproducer recipe

`ORIENTED_EDGE('',*,*,$,.T.)` or `ORIENTED_EDGE('',#v1,#v2,#180,.F.)` (deriveds non-`*`).

## Expected kernel behavior

tolerate either form on read; emit `*` for derived attributes on write per Part-21 §6.4.4.

## Notes

Mantis 0029979 also covers null EDGE_CURVE. **See also**: Twi004, Twi005.
